title: Wait! I Have Vuln!
description:
For the moment your teammate swings first while you hold Bash. This mod shows who holds a card that applies Vulnerable, so your team applies it before the big hits.

[b]Only the players who want to see it need the mod. The host does not.[/b] It does not affect gameplay, so it cannot desync a run, and friends without it can still play.

[h2]What you see[/h2]
During a co-op combat:

[h3]Vulnerable icon[/h3]
A player's name in the top-left player list gets the Vulnerable icon while they hold a supported card. It is bright when they can play the card, and dimmed when they cannot, such as without the energy.

[h3]"Wait! I have vuln!"[/h3]
Your teammate's character says it in a speech bubble when their icon turns bright and an enemy needs Vulnerable. The first bubble of each combat is always this line; later ones vary, and some call you by name.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/8fc7896d2e486b75d918c4a64acb61430aba0251/docs/images/hero.jpg[/img]

[h3]Card reminder[/h3]
While a teammate's icon is bright, a thought cloud appears beside each Attack you hover and can play.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/8fc7896d2e486b75d918c4a64acb61430aba0251/docs/images/card-cloud.jpg[/img]

[h3]Teammates' reactions[/h3]
Play the Attack anyway, and your teammate reacts, angrier with each Attack that turn. Lines include "Nooo!", "I HAD VULN!", and "I'm writing this down."
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/8fc7896d2e486b75d918c4a64acb61430aba0251/docs/images/reaction.jpg[/img]

[h3]Teammate's hand[/h3]
Hover the card count next to a teammate's name to see their hand.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/8fc7896d2e486b75d918c4a64acb61430aba0251/docs/images/hand-preview.jpg[/img]

[b]Supported cards:[/b]
[list]
[*]Ironclad: Bash, Break, Dominate, Taunt, Thunderclap, Tremble, Uppercut
[*]Silent: Assassinate, Expose
[*]Defect: Beam Cell
[*]Necrobinder: Fear, High Five, Putrefy
[*]Regent: Comet, Falling Star, Gamma Blast, Know Thy Place, Meteor Shower
[*]Colorless and event cards: Shockwave, Squash, and Mad Science made with Sapping at the Tinker Time event
[/list]

[h2]Settings[/h2]
On the main menu, open Settings > Mod Settings > Wait! I Have Vuln! and use the mouse. The game locks these settings during a run.
[list]
[*][b]Show icon on my own row[/b]
[*][b]Icon size:[/b] 50% to 150%.
[*][b]Teammate hand preview[/b]
[*][b]Show bubbles:[/b] off also hides the thought cloud and the reactions.
[*][b]Card reminder[/b]
[*][b]Varied bubble lines:[/b] off keeps one line for each bubble, "Wait! I have vuln!" or "Nooo!".
[/list]

[h2]Good to know[/h2]
[list]
[*]A dimmed icon still matters: your energy card or potion can let that player play the card.
[*]An enemy with Artifact does not trigger the bubble, cloud, or reactions, because Vulnerable would only remove its Artifact.
[*]The game's own speech bubbles come first, so a bubble from the mod can wait or be skipped.
[*]The bubble text is always English.
[*]The hand preview needs a mouse; it does not open with a controller.
[*]The hand preview also opens over the draw pile and deck views, because the game keeps the player list live there.
[*]Needs game version 0.107.1 or newer.
[*]In single-player the mod shows nothing.
[*]Not tested yet: Mad Science made with Sapping, the hand preview's numbers after a teammate's Strength, Weak, or cost changes, using the settings with a controller, macOS, Linux, and Steam Deck.
[/list]

[h2]Where did my saves go?[/h2]
With mods on, the game uses separate save profiles, so your unlocks look gone at first. Your normal saves are untouched. To copy your normal progress into the modded profile, follow the [url=https://github.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/blob/main/docs/modded-saves.md]save guide[/url].

[h2]Found a bug?[/h2]
Leave a comment here or [url=https://github.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln/issues]open an issue on GitHub[/url], and include the lines containing [noparse][WaitIHaveVuln][/noparse] from %APPDATA%\SlayTheSpire2\logs\godot.log.

[h2]Source[/h2]
Code, save guide, and changelog: [url=https://github.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln]github.com/awieczork/sts2-wait-i-have-vuln[/url]
